_comment: DO NOT GUESS, and DO NOT SHIP EXAMPLE DATA HERE — a prior version of this file shipped two fictional 'SLC'/'SA' free-coverage entries labeled Example: in their notes, but the rendered UI showed them as a flat, unqualified 'free coverage' badge with no indication they were placeholder — a real visitor had no way to tell that from the owner's original personal friend network being genericized, not a fact about the location or clinic. Removed entirely (2026-08-09) per direct user feedback: 'we do not have that based on me, that's bullshit, we are removing that entirely.' backup_care_available below MUST stay empty in this shipped file — it exists only as the shape the per-user localStorage override (lib/profile-store.ts) merges into at runtime. Never add a hub here again, example or otherwise.
rule: Never assign backup-care coverage from a model. Only the user sets it (backup_care_available, below, is user-stated example data, not a guess). Ranking MUST NOT depend on guessed coverage — rank on pay, nights, drive-vs-fly, payout timing, eligibility. home_base is any city the visitor enters (lib/types.ts's HomeBase) — 'austin'/'omaha' are not special-cased anywhere; drivable-vs-fly is computed from the coordinates below via lib/scoring.ts's haversine distance check, not a hardcoded per-city hub list.
